# opsolete_variable_set_workspace (Resource)

Applies a variable set to a workspace (not global or project sets: a repository-linked workspace gets only sets attached to it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A repository-linked workspace gets only sets attached to it.
resource "opsolete_variable_set_workspace" "azure_prd" {
  variable_set_id = opsolete_variable_set.azure_prd.id
  workspace_id    = opsolete_workspace.shop.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `variable_set_id` (String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <variable_set_id>/<workspace_id>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opsolete_variable_set_workspace.azure_prd <variable_set_id>/<workspace_id>
```
